ppage.text: The last time we saw Penny she'd earned enough money for her trip back home. Now, after a long sea voyage, she's finally back!
While she was away the standard of food got really bad... but ever-industrious Penny sees this as an opportunity!
She decides to start her own restaurant chain. But she could sure use a little help... you up for it?
OK good work! But there are more challenges ahead. So lets move on and take the next territory!
Come on!! Let's help Penny take her restaurant chain across Antarctica!
Here we go... it's the first stop on our tour of Antarctica!
Next stop on the map and everyone seems friendly enough. Hope they like Penny's cooking!
The last stop on our Antarctic journey! Penny's so excited!!!
And the award for the most popular restaurant in Antarctica goes to..... Penny!! (We couldn't have done it without you!)
Great news! The restaurant is a hit!!!
Nice!! Hiring Chef Pete will add more yummy dishes to the menu!
Good call! Chef Alby is famous for his seafood specials and his quick cooking!
Awesome! Chef Sully's speed in the kitchen is legendary! And so is his delicious menu!
We need new dishes to excite our customers! Maybe we should hire a new chef!
Excellent, now we can afford an upgrade! Must check out that catalog...
